description: Handle pasted screenshots and images. The user uses a local script (sspaste on their Mac) to ship a clipboard image from their Mac to the remote server. When the user mentions pasting an image, a screenshot, or gives you a path like ~/pi-paste-*.png, use the read tool to load it. Triggered by phrases like "paste image", "I sent a screenshot", "here's a screenshot", "take a look at this image", or providing a ~/pi-paste-* path.
